visual_dna: Western medieval fantasy as expressive Japanese sumi-e on warm washi, in one legible illustrated travel journal. Rough dry-brush charcoal ink, feathered atmospheric washes and unpainted negative space make each discovered place feel memorable. Restrained muted vermilion communicates meaningful danger, seals or rivals; do not default to old blue-green/aged-gold manuscript styling. Preserve already approved combat actor identity and oblique camera anchors.
fixed_avoid: unconnected road tiles where ADR-0014 applies
baked-in labels, logos or process UI

background.purpose: Render one discovered Crownless location as an evocative but readable medieval-fantasy sumi-e illustration on warm washi, with clear landmark identity and a sense that the player may return.

composition.framing: wide 16:9 ink-wash environment with one distinct discoverable landmark, readable approach and generous paper negative space

palette: soft gray-brown weathered stone and earth
small muted vermilion for gameplay-significant threat or seal only
discovery_language: the place reads as newly found, with hints of history and traversal
one clear landmark silhouette remains recognizable at 360–430 CSS px
atmospheric ink wash is expressive, not a sepia effect on stock vector art
world imagery shares the Western medieval fantasy × sumi-e on washi language
forbidden: characters or creatures unless explicitly requested
text, labels, logos, game UI or process metadata baked into art
photorealistic, painterly or cinematic generic fantasy scenery
default teal/blue-green or aged-gold old-board palette
blackened grimdark background that destroys warm washi readability
glowing magical spectacle as generic decoration
copying identity, objects or composition from rejected or unrelated candidates
using real-world POI photographs as the location visual

compare: expressive sumi-e dry-brush and ink-wash grammar on warm washi
current ivory/charcoal/sparse-vermilion palette rather than historical board
distinct landmark silhouette and phone-scale readability
background belongs to current map/town/forge/event image family
discoverable location mood without baked-in text

it could be generic glossy or cinematic fantasy from another RPG
